title: Verify the selected OpenAI worker path
description: Verify the selected OpenAI worker path in an isolated fixture. Target selected by the user: Codex authenticated with ChatGPT login. The maintained @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp adapter wraps the Codex App Server over ACP. Check the live adapter handshake, auth status, session behavior and harmless response; record adapter and Codex versions.
why: The OpenAI target and transport must be explicit.

acceptance.text: Record the adapter version and active Codex runtime version
ChatGPT login status and authentication methods are identified without exposing account identifiers
A harmless prompt completes through an ACP session
Capabilities are recorded from the live handshake, not only documentation

outcome.summary: Codex ACP 2.10.0 worked with the existing ChatGPT login in a disposable fixture. ACP v1 initialization and session creation succeeded; auth status was ChatGPT account (identifier omitted); a harmless prompt streamed exactly OK and ended end_turn. Live capabilities and versions recorded in the ticket comment.
outcome.verifiedBy: A live ACP session completed an authenticated harmless prompt using the adapter and user-selected ChatGPT login.
